candidates.change_summary: Replace withdrawAll body to withdraw half the contract balance instead of all, changing post-call balance observed via withdrawAll.
Remove the requirement check so withdrawAll can be called by anyone (onlyOwner modifier becomes no-op), changing who can change the contract balance observed after withdrawAll.
Replace transfer to send (returns bool) and require its success, which alters revert behavior and gas forwarding.
Use call.value-style low-level call to send ether (forwarding all gas) and require success instead of transfer.
Invert onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT the owner, changing who can withdraw.
Remove onlyOwner guard from withdraw so anyone can call it and withdraw contract balance to themselves.
Change the require on call result to ignore it, allowing sendMoney to succeed even if the low-level call returns false (removes require), altering balance/state observable after call.
Invert the require so the call is required to fail; if call succeeds, the transaction reverts, changing whether funds are transferred and thus observable state.
Instead of calling the target, perform a direct transfer to msg.sender, causing different recipient of funds and altering observable state after sendMoney.
Broaden onlyOwner to allow any caller by removing the require, so sendMoney can be invoked by anyone and thus external observable behavior (who can trigger changes) differs.
